articles.title: Bitcoin's U.S. reserve still a work-in-progress as federal agencies hash it out
articles.snippet: The White House says it's still evaluating the "best structure" for the federal fund to hold bitcoin as a long-term reserve and a separate stockpile of other crypto assets.

articles.title: Circle’s USDC is leaving Tether behind in the stablecoin volume race, new data from Visa shows
articles.snippet: As Wall Street banks adopt digital currencies for faster settlements, overall trading volume spiked 63% in just a single month.

articles.title: Strategy selling hundreds of millions worth of bitcoin raises question about its capital-allocation playbook
articles.snippet: First, it was a tiny amount of bitcoin sales; then, the purchase of several thousand BTC; and finally, today, the unloading of thousands of BTC. What's happening at Strategy?

articles.title: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf soars on a $19 billion AI data-center lease with Anthropic
articles.snippet: The onetime pure bitcoin miner signed a 20-year deal to host the AI firm at a Kentucky campus, the latest crypto-adjacent company to trade mining for the steadier money in artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

articles.title: Nigel Farage to resign from UK Parliament amid crypto “gift” scandal, will stand in by-election
articles.snippet: The Reform party leader and Brexit champion confirmed that he was the subject of probes by UK authorities following reports of what he called “gifts” from figures tied to cry pto ventures.
